text:
Alex: Heads up — ACME/SI joint announcement targeted in 3 wks. We need to lock marketplace security artifacts and an intake cadence. What do we absolutely need now?

Maria: SOC2 Type II (signed PDF preferred), pen-test executive summary (redacted), vuln scan report (authenticated scan summary), completed supplier security questionnaire, data processing topology (diagram), and statement of data residencies.

Jordan: Pen tests: we accept 3rd-party reports but must have scope, test dates, CVE references, and a short vendor remediation statement for any open findings. If only raw tool output, we need a human-readable summary.

Samira: I'll run the intake. Plan: presigned S3 upload window + one consolidated tracker doc. Partners should upload under their partner-id prefix. I'll create ticket and paste links here.

Chris: For diagrams: eng-infra can sanitize network drawings. Do we require PCAPs or raw logs for any listing? Also, define blackbox vs greybox expectation.

Maria: No PCAPs. Redacted logs/screenshots and reproducible steps are fine. For hardware partners (HSM/edge devices) include firmware attestation and SBOM or supply-chain statement.

Nina: Legal: confirm NDA covers uploads. If not, send intake form + upload agreement. Partners must redact PII and secrets before upload; we can't host private keys.

Jordan: Quick redaction snippet we give partners:
```
# redact emails
sed -E 's/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,6}/[REDACTED_EMAIL]/g' report.txt > report_redacted.txt
```
Also suggest removing full account IDs and access tokens.

compliance-bot: Template checklist: https://redwood.internal/checklists/marketplace-security-template — fields: SOC2, pen-summary, vuln-scan, questionnaire, topology. Add hw-attaestation and SI-integration notes if applicable.

Samira: I'll fork that checklist and add an "announcability" status field (ready / pending / partial) and a cutoff date for the 3-week announcement. Also will add an "acceptable age" rule: pen-test <=12 months OR plan for retest + current vuln scan.

Chris: I'll grab sanitized diagram snippets and a short note about network boundary semantics for the checklist. Also: ops asks that if partner uses shared infra we require their tenancy isolation statement.

Alex: Ok action items and owners — need artifacts in 10 business days to make the announcement. If not, fallback messaging: "security review in progress" on partner page.
- Samira: create ticket + presign links and checklist fork :white_check_mark:
- Maria: confirm SOC doc acceptance format (letter vs PDF attestation) :white_check_mark:
- Jordan: produce pen-report acceptance checklist and redaction guidance :white_check_mark:
- Chris: provide sanitized network diagrams :white_check_mark:

Samira: assigning to @Chris and @Maria. I'll post the ticket link in 1hr. @Nina please confirm NDA intake text when you can.
